name: staticchaos-docker
description: Dockerized Static Chaos MUD + world/data tooling (maps, items, bestiary, PDFs)

scripts.build:data: node tools/build-world-map.mjs && node tools/build-world-graph.mjs && node tools/build-items.mjs && node tools/build-bestiary.mjs && node tools/build-spawns.mjs && node tools/build-shops.mjs && node tools/build-gearing.mjs && node tools/build-classes.mjs && node tools/build-browser.mjs && node tools/build-d3-map.mjs
scripts.build:pdf: md-to-pdf world-maps/WORLD-ATLAS.md world-maps/ITEMS.md world-maps/BESTIARY.md world-maps/SPAWNS.md world-maps/SHOPS.md world-maps/CLASSES.md docs/GEARING-GUIDE.md
scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:pdf && npm run build:pdf:maps
